scope: Fixed DEV-only persistent engine/presence factor isolation. Cached previously measured warm production quality comparator; same 42 source clips, 14 language/condition cells and 56 reused controls. No held-out, Android acceptance or phone measurements.

policy.asr: Original .6 noSpeech/-1 logprob thresholds, beam3, CPU4, temperature/increment0, no_context=true, full1500 audio context. Same original base-q5_1 model and original whole float input/native padding; no automatic correction.
policy.presence: Exactly the previously reviewed CPU1 Silero5.1.2 causal-rms-cap30 whole-chunk precheck, frozen .5/250ms/600ms/15s/500ms/nooverlap. Reset VAD state per request. Empty ranges skip ASR without native JSON/profile and feed ordinary uncertain empty cue into actual Kotlin reconcile. Present ranges retain the entire original production chunk, never reframe.
policy.factor_isolation: Same true-topk+corrected-SOT+VADAPI library in both new arms, without RNG0 reset. The added arm does not apply VAD; the combined arm applies the existing whole-chunk presence policy.
policy.own_context: Replay the same frozen actual Kotlin gate/trustedContext/reconcile classes and source snapshot. Generate candidate prompts only from its own preceding committed passages, never references or baseline text. The baseline already used the same rule and retains its own prompts; changes after different decoded/cue outputs are recorded.
acceptance: No WER or CER increase in any of14 language/condition cells against the verified cached warm production baseline; report both full tables and every per-language combined count. Aggregate improvement cannot hide regressions.
All28 noise controls have zero native segments/empty decoded output with an ordinary uncertain cue; a skipped call has no fabricated ASR JSON/profile. Keep original audio/manual-edit semantics.

All28 positives retain exact text or strictly improve word/character errors with neither worse; no new empty output and no changed-text error tie. Preserve the previous strict gate before seeing new candidate outputs.

Review every changed/newly-empty DEV output and every introduced critical reference error, including short negation/number/date/time/entity changes and downstream context changes. Keep lexical flags and unresolved adjudications open; no automatic adoption.

A claim of quality improvement for every supported language additionally requires strict combined WER improvement for each of7 languages without CER increase. Compatibility alone or unchanged languages do not close that broader requirement.

timing_scope: Sequential host diagnostic durations contended with Android/manual QA. Cached baseline durations are not a matched timing comparator; no speed ranking.
